declarations.description: Share a link anywhere, like the share dialogs of Notion, Figma and YouTube: the link with a copy button, a row of targets (email, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, …), the device's own share sheet where there is one, and an optional QR code. It opens as a `c2-sheet`, from the bottom by default (`side`). `url` is what is shared, `heading` names it ("Share “Trip to Lisbon”") and `text` goes with it where the target takes text. `targets` picks the targets, `;`-separated, from `email`, `sms`, `x`, `linkedin`, `facebook`, `whatsapp`, `telegram` and `reddit`; copying the link is always there. `qr` adds a QR code of the link. Only an http(s) link is offered: anything else leaves the sheet empty, with nothing to share or copy. `share()` is what a Share button calls: it opens the device's share sheet (`navigator.share`) where there is one, and this sheet otherwise. Every target fires a cancelable `share` with `{ target, url }` before it opens (in a new tab, without a referrer); cancel it to handle that target yourself. The targets show the network's initial on a neutral tile: no trademarked logo is drawn. An app with licensed artwork puts it in the target's slot (``).
